note: Power claims as reviewable data (Cobe's pricing gate). pools/direct/influence carry the ruled state; proposals await Cobe's ruling and are promoted into direct only by his word. The model (_power_model.py) reads this file and writes power fields into graph.json; do not hand-edit graph.json power fields.

prometheus.why: Fire and all arts as the mythic origin of combustion and craft; Aeschylus PB 505-506 outright sums it [6]; Plato documents the transfer [7].

volundr.why: Smith-king of the Germanic tradition; revenge executed precisely through metalwork [24][25]; share small but the attribution is absolute within its domain.

machaon.why: Battlefield medicine personified; the Iliad prices the healer explicitly at several men [1]; Gerenia cult sustained a healing economy locally [3].

asclepius.why: Pandemic-scale healing cult of the ancient world; father-source of Machaon line [1][3]; Apollo/Asculapius branding persists on modern medicine.

genius.why: Tutelary of every person and place [9][10][14]: the pool of selfhood-ritual answers to it structurally, no myth needed.

sandman.why: The sleep-enforcer of the nursery [4]; psychoanalytic tradition (Freud) made it the canonical figure of the unheimlich night [5].

lilith.why: Infant-protection economy literally documented as her price (amulet with three angel names) [19]; night-fear persists in Isaiah/Huluppu strata [17][18][20].

rhiannon.why: Horse association is a penance in the primary witness [21] and the goddess claim scholarship [23]; the equine economy still runs under her modern name.

george-washington.why: State-commissioned national tutelary [16]; his biography industry was Weems [15]; the US national pool is the pool the name organizes.

zeus.why: The distribution of political wisdom itself stays in his keeping [7]; ancient sovereign order answers to the name.

hephaestus.why: The forge the fire was stolen from [7]; divine artisan of the Greek pool.

heracles.why: Labors as licensed force; release of Prometheus anchors him into the machine [6].

nithuth.why: A king who commands force sufficient to maim an elf-smith [24]; pool share is a throne-share, small.

inana.why: Owner of the halub-tree and its throne/bed claim [17]; Sumerian sovereignty-adjacent.

athene.why: Co-owner of the burgled crafts with Hephaestus [7].

epona.why: Epigraphic horse-cult, carried by cavalry [23]; absorbed into the modern equine economy only residually.

minerva.why: Ovid logs schoolmasters paying her fees at the Quinquatrus and credits her with attracting new pupils [36]; the education economy has a named patroness with a documented revenue stream.

james-watt.why: The SI unit of every pool in this graph is his name; the Soho works sold power itself as a commodity [39]. The man is the denomination of the modern fire economy Prometheus claims as mythic origin.

benjamin-franklin.why: Drew lightning into a Leyden jar and published directions [40]; the lightning rod and the unpatented stove make electrification and heating his personal doing, gift-form intact.

mars.why: Ovid's census: the god of Latium 'the patron of the sword; 'twas the sword that won for a fierce race empire and glory' [36]. The Roman military economy worshipped him by name, at the month-charging start of the year.

hippocrates.why: Founder of the first billing discipline in medicine [42]; the Asclepiadae descent claim [3] makes the descent-line explicit rather than analogy.

fdr.why: Asked for and received the war-emergency office in peacetime words [45]; the national pool was his instrument for four terms, the Cincinnatus-loan never visibly returned.

henry-knox.why: The artillery branch and the War Department both descend from his office; bodies under command documented in the cabinet roster witness.
henry-knox.role: Chief of the Continental Army artillery; first U.S. Secretary of War

alexander-hamilton.why: The Treasury he built still issues the credit of the pool Washington organizes.

thomas-jefferson.why: State department and the organizing creed of the same nation-pool.
thomas-jefferson.role: Secretary of State in the first cabinet

john-jay.why: The judicial arm of the same national coordination pool.

james-wilson.why: The court's claim on sovereign order runs through the frame he signed.

aaron-burr.why: One heartbeat from the pool's command; Weems' roll of damned talent.

benedict-arnold.why: Documented command of a strategic garrison before the defection.

charles-lee.why: Commanded at Monmouth against Washington's order; command documented, conduct separate.

edward-braddock.why: Led the expedition Washington survived; command of the Redcoat column is documented.

faraday.why: Every generator on the grid runs on the effect; parallel to Watt's denomination claim.

newton.why: The mechanics every engine is computed in; pool alternative P_metals (Mint coinage) if you prefer the office over the frame.
newton.role: Principia; Master of the Mint; Royal Society president

cincinnatus.why: The civil-military restraint template every modern republic cites; FDR borrowed the loan in his first inaugural.
cincinnatus.role: Roman dictator who returned the fasces

sulla.why: The strongman template the modern authority pool still measures itself against.

romulus.why: The founder-exemplar every nation-founding ritual borrows.

numa-pompilius.why: The pontifical and calendar architecture he instituted organized Roman religion for centuries.
numa-pompilius.role: Second king of Rome; cult author

fabius-maximus.why: Fabian strategy is taught by name in every staff college; the doctrine of strategic patience.

marcellus.why: The general's triumph ritual and siege command, documented in two primaries.
marcellus.role: Five-time consul; spolia opima; took Syracuse

marcius-coriolanus.role: Exiled general who turned on his own city

aemilius-paullus.why: Commanded the legion that ended the Macedonian phalanx.

cato-elder.why: The censor's audit of senators and contracts is the ancestral form of the accountability office.

valerius-publicola.why: The republican handover exemplar, in Plutarch and Livy both.
valerius-publicola.role: The consul who yielded the fasces

agamemnon.why: Leader of the host at Troy; the epic archcommander whose summons binds the Achaean kings.

priam.why: King of Troy; the throne the whole Iliad pressures.

aeneas.why: Founder-commander carrying the household gods to Latium; the exile-claim at the root of the Roman order.

evander.why: Arcadian king on the future site of Rome; hosts the Trojan remnant.

latinus.why: Latin king whose daughter transfers the kingship line.

odin.why: The All-Father; hanged for wisdom, one-eyed for the runes; sovereign of the Norse pantheon.

math.why: Lord of Gwynedd in the Fourth Branch; the name-making and flower-making uncle holds the northern throne.

maelgwn.why: Historical king of Gwynedd cast in the Taliesin tale as captor and judge of poets.

nuada.why: King of the Tuatha De Danann; the hand-lost king re-armed in silver, the sovereignty that must be whole.

balor.why: Fomorian king whose death-eye held a host; the tyrant-eye his grandson closes at Moytura.

manannan.why: Sea-lord named in the euhemerist lists; the otherworld ferryman-king.

hel.why: Half-dead ruler of the ninth world and its low house; the underworld throne Odin granted her.

nithuths-queen.why: The queen who reads the ring and commands the hamstringing; the instigating throne beside Nithuth.

apollo.why: The archer whose arrows are plague and whose son is Asclepius; the healing claim the Pythian voice disciplined. Pricing activates the sibyl and Sulla routes.

mercury.why: God of merchants and messengers; the exchange-coordination archetype the market still invokes. Pricing activates the Adam Smith route.

atlas.why: The sky-bearer; every atlas of maps and every load-bearing name descends from the Titan condemned to carry. Pricing activates the Iopas route.

paris-alexandrus.why: The judgment of the apple: the binding decision among the bribes of three goddesses that launched the war. Pricing activates the Hector route.

god.why: King of kings in the fetched texts (Rev. 19:16 [318]); the flesh-record invocations address him as the seat of authority (Weems [15], Franklin [40], Roosevelt [45]). Share at the Tier-2 anchor; rescale by ruling.
god.role: named sovereign of the scriptural corpus

jesus.why: The gospels document the healing practice ('they brought unto him all that were diseased', Matt. 4:24 [318]) and the authority claim ('All power is given unto me', Matt. 28:18 [318]); Pliny documents the cult addressing him 'as to a god' [321]. Health pool proposed; an authority share is the alternative; rescale by ruling.
jesus.role: healing practice and the authority claim

pop_anchors_why: watts_at_era prices a figure in the coin of their own time: watts_now x world-pop(era)/pop(2026), population as the energy proxy, log-linear between cited anchors (replaces the two-endpoint curve that overpriced 1800 ~6x and underpriced -750 ~2x).

pontius-pilate.why: Procurator in Tacitus [320] and Josephus [319], governor of Judaea in Luke 3:1 [318]; the office that passed the death sentence in all four witnesses. Small share for a small province's command.

tiberius.why: The princeps named by Tacitus as the reign of the execution (Ann. 15.44) [320] and by Luke as the dating emperor (Luke 3:1) [318]; Josephus routes the frontier war orders through him (Ant. 18.5.1) [319]. Tier-2 ceiling share.

herod-antipas.why: Tetrarch under Tiberius (Luke 3:1) [318]; Josephus documents the Baptist's killing as his security decision (Ant. 18.5.2) [319].

moses.why: The Exodus commission is a host command in the witness: 'I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt' (Exod. 3:10) [317]; Josephus frames him as the lawgiver [319].
